## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] A test covers the behaviour I changed, and `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] The docs and screenshots affected by the change are updated
- [ ] It identifies, verifies and refuses rather than guessing
- [ ] No secrets, no real titles or sites, no personal paths in the code, docs or examples
- [ ] If it touches downloads, archives, logging or credentials, the description says what it protects against
